resources.string:
A quick tile was added to the statusbar to take a screenshot.

To use it edit the mosaics then move the take screenshot tile to the desired position.

Click on the tile to take a screenshot.

Keep in mind that the color and font of the mosaic will depend on your Android version and the theme that you or the phone manufacturer is using.
Accessibility service is mandatory to allow to take screenshots on Android Pie (API 28) and higher.

Select the delay before taking the screenshot.\n\nWe recommend a delay to at least 600 milliseconds to allow time for the notifications list to be closed before the screenshot is taken, although the minimum time required will depend on your specific device.

This app requires accessibility permission to work properly.\n\nPress the \"Accept\" button to open the accessibility permission management screen or the \"Cancel\" button to close this dialog without granting accessibility permission.
Vibrate briefly when a screenshot is taken.
Show the tile with a colored background when accessibility is granted.
